title: Signature Graphics / single color focus
slide_intent: Limit competing accents so the viewer can identify the focal element in a graphic composition.
strategic_value: A single color highlight can give DB scenes emphasis while retaining calm context.
demonstration: A pale skyline with one lilac building is compared with a crossed-out multicolored skyline.
practical_value: Highlight individual elements without coloring one graphic in multiple contrasting brand colors.

content_islands.name: Focused skyline
content_islands.spec: Use pale gray context and one lilac accent at left.

content_islands.name: Competing colors
content_islands.spec: Cross out the red, lilac and dark multicolored version at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The comparison shows a focal accent against a restrained scene.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source prohibits a signature graphic colored in several contrasting DB Digital Red, Transitional Lilac, Clear White and Cold Black tones.
